_description: Smart Parking Management System - System Configuration

camera._source_help: int = webcam index | string = video file path | string = rtsp://... for IP cam

model._path_help: Path to trained YOLO model. Falls back to yolov8n.pt if not found.
model._conf_help: Detections below this confidence are treated as UNCERTAIN
model._device_help: auto = CUDA if available else CPU | 0 = GPU 0 | cpu = CPU

temporal_filter._occupied_help: Number of consecutive OCCUPIED candidate frames before confirming OCCUPIED state
temporal_filter._free_help: Number of consecutive FREE candidate frames before confirming FREE state
temporal_filter._uncertain_help: Frames without any detection before state becomes UNCERTAIN

slot_mapping._overlap_help: Minimum IoU overlap between bounding box and slot polygon to assign vehicle
slot_mapping._center_help: If true, use bbox center point for polygon matching (simpler). If false, use overlap.

serial._port_help: Update to your actual ESP32 COM port before running
serial._send_help: How often to send status packets to ESP32
serial._lost_help: Declare COMMUNICATION_LOST if no ACK received in this many seconds
